about_the_game:
In modern society, the protagonist has just become a novice Zashiki-warashi (a traditional Japanese house spirit). With no home of her own to haunt, she visits Warashi Realty in search of a place to settle. However, she soon learns that in order to be entrusted with introducing houses, she must first prove her abilities as a spirit through training under the company’s owner—a veteran elder Zashiki-warashi with centuries of experience. As she endures the trials of her training, the protagonist begins to uncover the mysteries of her own past and the secrets hidden within Warashi Realty…

This game is an experimental exploration title built with 3D scans of real apartments in Tokyo. Search through the rooms, discover yokai disguised as everyday objects, and overcome a series of unique challenges.

Estimated Playtime:

60–120 minutes

Options:

  • Camera shake

  • Camera controls (sensitivity, normal / inverted)

  • Field of view

  • Motion blur

  • Audio volume

  • Graphics quality (system load)

All settings can be adjusted immediately after the opening sequence.
If you are prone to motion sickness, we recommend turning Camera Shake and Motion Blur off, and setting a wider field of view.
If performance feels heavy, we suggest setting Graphics Quality to 2.

Streaming and Video Content:

Streaming is welcome! Please see the official guidelines on the Studio Hi website for details.

name: Spook Ltd.: Warashi Homes
short_description: This is the story of a modern Zashiki-warashi who visits a mysterious real estate agency in search of a home to haunt. Explore real apartments in Tokyo, uncover mischievous yokai disguised as everyday furniture and household items, and delve into the mysteries of Warashi Realty.
